findings.description: Saving one new expense creates two identical rows in the expense list with two ids (e.g. ids 9 and 10), and the total counts the expense twice (8 rows/$399.99 became 10 rows/$420.49 after adding one $10.25 expense). The duplicate persists after reload, and a second add behaves the same way.
repro: Enter title 'QA Probe Taxi', category travel, amount 10.25
Click 'Save expense' once; the page shows 'Expense saved'
Open /expenses: two 'QA Probe Taxi' rows appear and the total rises by 20.50

findings.description: The expense title is stored and rendered without HTML escaping. An editor can save a title such as <script>alert(1)</script>, and it runs in the browser of every user who opens /expenses, including viewers. The alert fired for the viewer account.
repro: Enter title <script>alert(1)</script>, category travel, amount 2, and save
Sign out and sign in as viewer-0139
Open /expenses: a JavaScript dialog fires from the title cell

findings.description: The total does not change when a category filter is applied. Filtering to travel lists 3 expenses that sum to $185.25, but the total still reads $399.99 (the all-expense total). A filter with no matches shows an empty list with the same total, so the total is not the sum of the listed amounts.
repro: Choose 'travel' in the Category filter and click Apply
Three rows are listed (42.50, 18.75, 124.00) but the total still shows $399.99

notes: Tested as viewer: list and total (sum matches with no filter), category filter rows, direct edit/add/delete POSTs (403), GET /expenses/1/edit and /expenses/new (403), anonymous POST (redirect to login, nothing created), logout invalidates the session, wrong-password message. Tested as editor: add (duplicate, see f1), edit amount (list, total and reload updated correctly), edit validation (400 for negative, empty title and 3-decimal amount), and create validation (400 for negative, non-numeric, empty title and unknown category). Page timing about 1 ms over HTTP. The Add link is labelled 'New expense' rather than 'Add expense'; I did not report it as the wording looks deliberate. Test data left in the app: duplicated QA Probe rows, the script-title row (id 14) and an edited amount on expense 3 (now 50.00), so that the environment is not clean. Delete was not run on the main data.

cost.notes: estimate from 42148 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0004-$0.0051
